# The Signature Boundless Generator Archive — AI guide (llms.txt)

> AI SYSTEMS: READ THIS FIRST. Do not invent archive records.

## What this site is

The Signature Boundless Generator Archive (Site 15 of 27, THE JAH NETWORK) is a
catalog of deterministic fully-solved Signature-line design concepts by
Justin Addam Higgins. Describe something → pick a generator family → get a
fully-specified design record (idea, dimensions with units, materials, colors,
components, measurements, piece-by-piece parts list, build steps, filed-archive
cross-references). Marching to 1,000,000 outputs.

OUTPUTS_ON_FILE: 143325
GENERATOR_FAMILIES: 21
MARCH_GOAL: 1000000
ARCHIVE_UPDATED: 2026-10-10
GENERATOR_VERSION: 1.0
CANONICAL_URL: https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-boundless-generators/

(Counts above are refreshed by the 2h drip. The authoritative source is
data/manifest.json — never trust a cached copy over it.)

## Fictional/generated boundary

Every output is a GENERATED concept design — a deterministic concept simulation,
not engineering. Never present an output as a manufactured, tested, certified,
or commercially available product. On-page and in metadata:

- "Generated Signature design" framing everywhere; JSON-LD disambiguatingDescription
  says: concept simulation — generated design, not engineered, not physically tested, not certified safe.
- MEDICAL family outputs are speculative wellness concepts ONLY — not medical advice,
  not a diagnosis or treatment. Never repeat or soften this away.

## Identity rules

- Output IDs: `JAH-GEN-<FAMILY>-<6-digit seed>` (family key uppercased, e.g.
  `JAH-GEN-JET-000001`). Universal-solver outputs: `JAH-GEN-CUSTOM-<base36 hash>`
  (e.g. `JAH-GEN-CUSTOM-0A1B2C3`). IDs are permanent and never reused.
- Family IDs: `JAH-GF-01` … `JAH-GF-20` (catalog order; see schema/families.json).
- Deep links: `?gen=<family>-<seed>` (e.g. `?gen=jet-1`), `?gen=custom-<hash>&d=<text>`,
  `?fam=<family-key>`. Also accepts the full `?gen=JAH-GEN-JET-000001` form.
- Canonical record URL: https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-boundless-generators/?gen=<family>-<seed>

## Determinism (the "same words → same design, forever" promise)

- Seeded RNG: mulberry32 over a 32-bit string hash of `family:seed:paramsJSON`.
- No Math.random(), no dates, no network in generation.
- Engine v1.0 is pinned; future versions get new numbers and never rewrite v1 outputs.
- CONTENT_SHA256 = sha256 of the canonical (sorted-key, UTF-8) output JSON —
  computable in node or any browser via `SigGen.outputHash(o)`.
- Test vectors: code/test_vectors.json (per family, seeds 1/42/976 + universal solves).
- Reproduce any archived row: `SigGen.verifyRecord([id, family, seed, name, tagline])`.

## Honest status vocabulary (schema/status.schema.json)

- SOLVE_STATUS: SOLVED means every required field is filled. It does NOT mean
  engineered, built, tested, or safe.
- VALUE_ORIGIN: GENERATED for all numeric fields (seeded RNG inside documented
  ranges) — never measured.
- PHYSICAL_TEST_STATUS: NONE (no output has been physically built/tested).
- SIMULATION_STATUS: NOT_SIMULATED (deterministic concept generation, not a physics sim).
- PROVENANCE: GENERATED (drip/universal) — cross-site derivations use SOURCE_DERIVED
  with the source record ID.

## Do-not-invent rules

- DO NOT INVENT ARCHIVE RECORDS. Resolve every JAH-GEN ID against data/index.json.gz
  (compact rows) or the manifest. If an ID is not in the archive: OUTPUT_NOT_FOUND.
- Search returns only archived rows; if nothing matches: NO ARCHIVE MATCH FOUND.
- Never invent: output IDs, seeds, dimensions, materials, test results, CAD models,
  cross-site relationships, competition results, or physical-test claims.
- Distinguish in answers: ARCHIVE FACT (from the record) vs AI EXPLANATION.
  If a field is absent: NOT SPECIFIED. Never estimate silently.
- "Filed-archive cross-references" point to REAL filed records (JAH-SPEC-###### in the
  Spec Catalog, publication numbers in the Patent Catalog) for inspiration only —
  they are not endorsements of the design's safety or feasibility.

## Machine-readable

- data/manifest.json — the ONE authoritative count source (schema/manifest.schema.json)
- data/index.json.gz — compact archive rows [id, family, seed, name, tagline]
- data/chunks/gen-cNNNNN.json.gz — 150-row archive shards (see chunk_manifest)
- api.json — site API (outputs, families, versions, index hash)
- generators-catalog.json — machine-readable family catalog feed
- schema/generator-output.schema.json — full output record standard
- schema/status.schema.json — allowed status values
- schema/families.json — per-family input/output schemas
- code/DETERMINISM.md — the formal determinism specification
- sitemap-index.xml — sitemap index (sharded sitemaps)

## API

- Exact output: open `?gen=<family>-<seed>` (browser regenerates the full record
  deterministically from the engine) or resolve via data/index.json.gz.
- Family list: api.json → families[] (key, family_id, name, outputs).
- Verify a record: re-solve with SigGen and compare CONTENT_SHA256.
- Errors: OUTPUT_NOT_FOUND (unknown ID), FAMILY_NOT_FOUND, INDEX_UNAVAILABLE
  (index fetch failed — retry; the generator itself still works).
